preflight: If products already live on Shopify, STOP — a theme redesign or headless Shopify (checkout stays on Shopify) beats rebuilding commerce on Stripe. This recipe is for stores starting from zero.

pages: checkout via Stripe Checkout (hosted — don't build your own)
notes: Products/orders in Supabase; Stripe Checkout owns the payment page
auth optional: guest checkout is the v1 default
